baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled patience root, the possessors of resolve, the messengers, the ban on hastening, and the standalone proclamation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The imperative and its messenger exemplar form a control loop: contain reactive distress, bind intention to the charge, keep a deliberate messenger pace, refuse premature acceleration, and continue until delivery.

activation_trace.role: Inward restraint against panic supplies the control that blocks reactive acceleration.
Decisive binding of the heart supplies fixed intention beneath that restraint.
Gentleness and deliberation give the messenger's movement its proper pace.
Speeding and bringing forward identify the pressure explicitly refused.
Carrying a message to its addressee makes faithful delivery, rather than scheduling, the work that remains.

changed_reading.before: Patience is passive endurance while waiting for punishment to arrive.
changed_reading.after: Patience is disciplined custody of a commission: restrain reactive urgency, keep intention fixed, preserve a deliberate messenger pace, and complete delivery without taking control of the timetable.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The day of seeing the promise, the denial of a long stay, the daylight fraction, and the proclamation that has reached its limit.
baseline_models.mechanism: A scheduled and even countable promise becomes visible at its endpoint; arrival then makes the preceding residence contract in retrospect to a bounded fragment of daylight.

activation_trace.role: A stretch of time supplies the scale later subjected to retrospective compression.
Seeing by eye and insight marks the point when the latent endpoint becomes undeniable.
A promise fixed to a time or place makes the endpoint scheduled rather than indefinite.
The split mapped inventory contributes counting, making the promised interval measurable rather than amorphous.
Residence in a place supplies the duration that is later judged negligible.
The opening span of daylight bounds the comparison by a visible daily interval.
Arrival at a limit closes the interval and enables its backward rescaling.

changed_reading.before: The verse contrasts a long worldly wait with a short remembered stay.
changed_reading.after: The visible endpoint reorganizes temporal scale: once the scheduled promise arrives, the whole inhabited interval registers as scarcely a daylight fraction.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The messengers, the proclamation, and the final restriction of destruction to the transgressing people.
baseline_models.mechanism: The message is sent and brought through to completion; the closing question then separates completed transmission from the communal rupture that culminates in loss.

activation_trace.role: Messenger and message supply the commission whose completion must be distinguished from its reception.
Delivery supplies a terminal marker for the messenger's responsibility.
A human collective makes the consequence social rather than an isolated accident.
A fruit breaking out of its shell supplies a material image of enacted departure from a containing order.
Collapse into loss and extinction supplies the endpoint of that departure.

changed_reading.before: The ending simply announces that a wicked group will be destroyed.
changed_reading.after: The ending closes the transmission contract and locates loss beyond it: delivery is completed, while destruction is restricted to a collective whose persistent action ruptures its containing order.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperative to persist and the isolated proclamation after the compressed account of residence.
baseline_models.mechanism: Alongside the delivery reading, the proclamation can activate sufficiency: enough provision is present to traverse the remaining stay, so patience is sustained passage rather than empty postponement.

activation_trace.role: Sufficiency one can live on recasts the isolated noun as enough provision for passage.
Bearing surety and remaining alongside others adds accountable accompaniment to endurance.
Continued residence supplies the span through which that sufficiency must carry the reader.

changed_reading.before: The isolated proclamation labels only a public announcement.
changed_reading.after: It can also name sufficiency: the verse gives enough orientation to carry the remaining stay without forcing its endpoint.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context turns duration into staged maturation: creation has an appointed limit, burden develops internally, maturity is reached, passage occurs degree by degree, and settlement is completed without deficit.

activation_trace.role: A temporal span is the focus interval whose apparent length is being re-evaluated.
Residence anchors the interval in lived duration rather than abstract chronology.
Reaching a limit supplies the terminal logic already latent in the focus.
A fixed end of a measured term makes the wait bounded from the outset.
Inner bearing and fruit supply an embodied process that remains hidden while it develops.
Repeated arrival at maturity makes attainment developmental rather than merely punctual.
Movement one degree at a time supplies ordered stages between beginning and settlement.
Full completion without shortage supplies the non-arbitrary finish of the process.

structural_cues: 46:3 pairs creation in truth with a named term; 46:15 measures bearing and repeated maturity; 46:19 places graded outcomes before complete repayment.
The repeated attainment in 46:15 gives the focus proclamation an embodied growth clock as well as a deadline.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fixed term, inner bearing, repeated attainment, graded passage, and full completion; I infer that these stages explain why non-haste can be purposeful maturation. A live alternative is that they are parallel temporal examples rather than one causal schedule.

changed_reading.before: Patience fills an unexplained delay before an externally imposed endpoint.
changed_reading.after: Patience inhabits an appointed maturation: much of the process is internally borne and traversed by degrees before it reaches a fully settled limit.

context_deltas.mechanism: Following revelation, warning, and delivering are assigned to the messenger; knowledge of timing is not. The opponents' demand for the threatened event and their later acceleration pressure the messenger to cross that boundary, so patience preserves jurisdiction as well as composure.

activation_trace.role: Self-restraint anchors the focus response to pressure.
The messenger role anchors what the addressee is actually charged to do.
Acceleration names the boundary-crossing impulse prohibited in the focus.
Following behind a given lead supplies the messenger's derivative rather than controlling position.
A divinely given report supplies the content that determines the messenger's course.
Warning that awakens caution defines the effect sought from delivery.
A threatened promise supplies the event opponents demand be produced on cue.
Knowledge as disclosure to a knower marks information the messenger explicitly does not possess independently.
Delivering a message identifies the positive task that remains within the messenger's charge.
Being sent with a message binds delivery to prior commission rather than personal control.
The opponents' own acceleration exposes the social pressure behind the focus prohibition.

structural_cues: 46:22 demands production of the threatened event; 46:23 answers by separating hidden timing knowledge from message delivery; 46:24 calls the arrival what they accelerated.
46:9 had already limited the messenger to following what is given and warning plainly.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies following, revelation, warning, a demanded threat, withheld timing knowledge, commissioned delivery, and opponent-driven acceleration; I infer that the prohibition guards a role boundary. It may alternatively be pastoral restraint without a jurisdictional claim.

changed_reading.before: Do not wish that their punishment would arrive quickly.
changed_reading.after: Do not let their challenge recruit you into controlling the schedule: patient faithfulness means transmitting and warning while refusing ownership of when the threatened event arrives.

context_deltas.mechanism: The approaching phenomenon is genuinely seen but wrongly read as beneficial rain; it is the very event they accelerated. Destruction leaves residences as visible residue, and the later public display fixes the truth. Seeing in the focus therefore includes correction of prior interpretation, not merely first visual contact.

activation_trace.role: Visual and inward seeing anchors the focus moment of recognition.
Refused acceleration anchors the relation between premature demand and failed interpretation.
Actual eyesight establishes that perceptual access alone does not guarantee a correct reading.
Something appearing from one side supplies an ambiguous approach whose identity must be interpreted.
Water descending from cloud supplies the expected relief projected onto the approach.
Punitive descent from cloud reverses the same rain image into the arriving threat.
Their acceleration makes the misread arrival answer their own demand.
Root-level eradication supplies the actual effect hidden by the rain expectation.
The narrowed field of what remains visible supplies a second, corrected act of seeing.
Inhabited dwellings become residue, reversing a place of settled life into evidence of absence.
Public exposure to view supplies the terminal correction of disputed reality.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies what the corrected sight must finally acknowledge.

structural_cues: 46:24 moves from sight to a confident but false rain reading and immediately reverses it into the accelerated threat.
46:25 reduces the visible scene to dwellings, while 46:34 stages explicit exposure and acknowledgment just before the focus verse.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sight, an ambiguous approach, expected and punitive rain branches, accelerated demand, erasure, residue, and final exposure; I infer that the focus seeing is interpretive correction. The live alternative is a separate end-time seeing with only analogical support from the earlier scene.

changed_reading.before: On the final day they will see the promised event for the first time.
changed_reading.after: The final seeing is a correction after mis-seeing: what had looked like relief can prove to be the very outcome they forced forward, and only the terminal exposure stabilizes its meaning.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context supplies hearing and sight capable of understanding, denial despite knowledge, repeated transformation of signs toward return, and destruction when return fails. The shell-exit image in the focus becomes a trajectory of refused reversibility rather than a static group label.

activation_trace.role: Breaking out of a shell supplies the focus image of enacted departure.
Collapse and extinction supply the terminal state whose selectivity the focus questions.
The repeated shell-exit image ties the final category to conduct already named in context.
Hearing as comprehension and compliance supplies a capacity that could have supported return.
Inward discernment supplies another available capacity, not merely an external organ.
Denial while knowing makes non-return active rather than informationally innocent.
A manifest marker supplies the evidence repeatedly available to perception.
Historical collapse supplies the realized endpoint of the trajectory.
Turning material from state to state supplies repeated variation intended to reopen response.
Returning from a wrong course supplies the reversible alternative offered before collapse.

structural_cues: 46:26 lists receptive faculties before saying they did not benefit; 46:27 states that signs were repeatedly varied so that return might occur.
The focus restriction to the transgressing people follows this failed return sequence rather than introducing an unprepared label.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies capacities for understanding, knowledgeable denial, varied signs aimed at return, and realized destruction; I infer a remedial sequence exhausted before collapse. The alternative is looser juxtaposition rather than a strict procedural threshold.

changed_reading.before: The transgressing people are a fixed condemned class to whom destruction simply applies.
changed_reading.after: Transgression names an enacted exit after available return is repeatedly reopened; destruction is the terminal state of refusing that reversibility, not the first move.

context_deltas.mechanism: The listeners hear with comprehension, become attentively silent, wait until the recitation is complete, orient themselves back toward their people, warn, identify an extended path, and call for response. Patience governs the order of action; it does not abolish urgency after reception is complete.

activation_trace.role: Restraint supplies the capacity not to interrupt or act before reception is complete.
Message-bearing anchors the later relay in the same communicative domain as the focus messengers.
Rejected acceleration distinguishes premature action from prompt action at the proper stage.
Hearing that includes understanding and compliance begins the ordered response.
Attentive silence supplies deliberate non-interruption while meaning is still arriving.
Completion and coming to an end supply the threshold after which movement becomes timely.
Turning the face toward a destination supplies directed return after completion.
Warning that awakens caution supplies the urgent purpose of their return.
An extended route supplies the durable course to which the warning directs its hearers.
Answering speech supplies prompt response once listening and relay have done their work.

structural_cues: 46:29 explicitly orders hearing, silence, completion, turning, and warning; 46:31 then commands response.
The sequence places restraint before completion and urgency after it, preventing both interruption and inert delay.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies comprehension, attentive silence, completion, directed return, warning, route, and response; I infer that the focus patience regulates sequence rather than speed in the abstract. The alternative is that the scene models listening etiquette without defining the final imperative.

changed_reading.before: Patience and urgency are opposites, so patient action must be slow.
changed_reading.after: Patience is sequence discipline: do not speak or act before reception is complete, but once it is complete, turn, warn, and seek response without delay.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate lead-in denies fatigue in creation, affirms effective capacity to revive the dead, then stages public exposure and lived encounter with reality. The delay behind the focus patience is therefore not exhausted capacity; the endpoint changes knowledge from disputed report to experienced fact.

activation_trace.role: Seeing anchors the focus transition from promised report to undeniable encounter.
Residence supplies the duration retrospectively compressed by that encounter.
Bodily weariness, explicitly negated, removes depleted effort as the cause of delay.
Effective power that reaches action supplies assured ability to produce the endpoint.
Loss of life supplies the state that effective power is asserted able to reverse.
Exposure before view changes an absent claim into an immediate presented reality.
Stable fit with reality supplies the truth acknowledged under exposure.
Experiential testing supplies a stronger mode of knowing than prior verbal notice.

structural_cues: 46:33 asks about creation, fatigue, and revival; 46:34 immediately shifts to exposure, acknowledgment, and experience; 46:35 begins with a consequential therefore.
This adjacency grounds the patience command in demonstrated capacity before it asks the reader to endure apparent delay.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies negated fatigue, effective power, reversible death, exposure, truth, and experience; I infer that delay is not incapacity and that temporal compression is partly epistemic. The alternative is that 46:33-34 establish doctrine without explaining the timing of 46:35.

changed_reading.before: Patience compensates for uncertainty about whether the promised endpoint can occur.
changed_reading.after: Patience follows from unwearied capacity: uncertainty lies in present access and timing, not ability, and the endpoint converts reported truth into exposure and experience that collapse the felt interval.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same promise root opens hope in the accepted trajectory and threat in the defiant trajectory; full repayment and the focus restriction on destruction preserve the asymmetry. The promised horizon can therefore sort responses rather than denote one undifferentiated catastrophe.

activation_trace.role: A verbal promise that opens hope preserves a beneficial side of the focus horizon.
A threatening promise preserves the punitive side carried by the same root.
Exit from a containing shell limits destructive fulfillment to an enacted trajectory.
Hope opened by a promised good supplies the accepted trajectory's future orientation.
Complete payment without shortage supplies equitable differentiation among trajectories.
The earlier shell-exit occurrence ties punitive fulfillment to practiced departure.
The demanded threat supplies the defiant trajectory's relation to the same promised horizon.

structural_cues: 46:16 frames promise as truthful good for accepted action, while 46:22 demands the threatened promise and 46:20 links punishment with practiced transgression.
The focus closes with an exception restricting destruction rather than universalizing it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hopeful promise, complete repayment, practiced shell-exit, and demanded threat; I infer one horizon differentiated by response. The live alternative is that the focus pronoun refers narrowly to opponents and only to punishment.

changed_reading.before: What they are promised is one uniformly punitive event.
changed_reading.after: The promised horizon is bifurcated by response: it opens hope along one trajectory and realizes threat along another, while destruction remains restricted to enacted departure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a meteorological branch is distant from the ordinary imperative, but it remains anchored in the focus patience root and in the nearby approaching-cloud and hastening sequence. Render it only as a secondary accumulation image, not as a lexical replacement for patience.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The patience imperative, the ban on acceleration, and the context's layered approaching weather event.

activation_trace.role: White cloud massed layer over layer supplies an image of accumulation before release.
An appearance advancing from one side gives the accumulated image a visible approach.
Cloud-borne water supplies the expected release of the gathered mass.
Punitive descent reverses the expected release and keeps accumulation morally unstable.
Acceleration supplies the attempt to force release before its meaning is known.

changed_reading.before: Patience is only an inward brake on emotion.
changed_reading.after: As a contained secondary image, patience also resembles allowing layers to gather until their proper release, while refusing to force an arrival whose apparent benefit may conceal reversal.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the mortality branch is remote from the ordinary temporal sense of an hour, yet it is anchored in the same focus root and the nearby destruction clause, with eradication immediately modeled in context. Render it as a death-saturated echo inside temporal compression, never as the direct translation of the time expression.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The single hour, the immediate question about destruction, and the contextual eradication that leaves dwellings.

activation_trace.role: The branch naming the dead supplies a mortality resonance inside the compressed hour.
Collapse into death and loss makes that remote resonance locally consequential.
Eradication in the preceding narrative gives the mortality echo a concrete contextual counterpart.

changed_reading.before: The hour functions only as a small unit of remembered duration.
changed_reading.after: The hour can carry a contained mortality echo: at the endpoint, compressed duration and the fate of the destroyed briefly occupy the same lexical field.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This material model is cross-domain and depends on a non-dominant split mapping for the rescue verb, so it must remain explicitly exploratory. It is still anchored by the focus shell-exit and collapse branches, while the context contributes protective covering and repair of a crooked fracture; render it as an analogy for recoverability, not morphology or doctrine.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The transgressor as shell-exiter and the restriction of collapse, read beside the context's offer of forgiveness and rescue.

activation_trace.role: A fruit leaving its shell supplies the breach from a protective form.
A covering that protects what it encloses supplies the first material of recovery.
The split mapped image of setting a crooked fracture supplies repair rather than mere escape.
Collapse and extinction supply what successful covering and repair would avert.

changed_reading.before: The final contrast permits only intact obedience or irreversible destruction.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory material analogy, shell-exit creates a breach that can still be covered and reset before collapse; the context's call to respond occupies that repair interval.

strongest_changes: Patience changed from passive waiting into disciplined custody of a message under a strict boundary between delivery and timing.
Seeing changed from first perception into late correction after an approaching threat had already been misread as relief.
The listening group showed that patience regulates sequence rather than speed: silence lasts through completion, then warning and response become urgent.
The final transgressor category changed from a static label into enacted departure after repeated opportunities for return, while promise split into hopeful and threatening fulfillment by trajectory.
summary.what_was_special: The context supplied two inverse motion patterns that the focus alone did not expose: opponents accelerate an arrival they misread, while receptive listeners wait for completion and then move promptly. Split mapped roots also kept countability, repair, and other secondary material readings live without displacing the ordinary syntax.
remaining_uncertainties: The isolated proclamation can mark delivered notice, reached endpoint, sufficient provision, or more than one of these at once.
The compressed stay may be psychological recollection, an ontological rescaling at exposure, or a narrower statement about worldly duration.
The approaching-cloud narrative strongly activates the final seeing and hastening language, but the final scene can still retain an independent end-time scope.
The stacked-cloud, mortality-hour, and fracture-repair models should remain qualified resonances rather than lexical substitutions.
